# Stage 1 results (generated by run_stage1.py)

Base parameters: `{'n_steps': 60, 'sigma': 5.0, 'half_spread': 1.0, 'impact': 30.0, 'r2': 0.01, 'half_life': 10.0, 'obs_noise': 1.0}`. Seeds: train 101 (10,000 episodes), validation 202 (20,000 episodes); test seed 303 not used in Stage 1. Costs are mean implementation shortfall in bps of arrival notional, including the half-spread. Intervals are paired, normal-approximation 95%. Runtime 193 s.

## Gate A — environment sanity

- PASS: No-signal control: planner equals TWAP exactly (max abs difference 0.0e+00 bps)
- PASS: No-signal control: no policy beats TWAP beyond noise (beaten by: none)
- PASS: No-signal control: urgency-rule beta tuned on training = 0.0632; best simple rule = TWAP
- PASS: Base case: no achievable policy beats the planner beyond noise (beaten by: none)
- PASS: Base case: privileged ceiling beats the planner (-0.643 bps)
- PASS: Base case: LQG reference action clipped in 43.7% of decisions (information only)
- PASS: Base case: urgency-rule beta tuned on training = 0.1; best simple rule = TWAP

## Gate B — headroom of the true-model planner over the best simple rule

Headroom = best simple rule cost − planner cost (positive means the planner is cheaper). Memory gain = latest-signal-only planner cost − planner cost. Gap to privileged = planner cost − privileged planner cost.
